'''Ithorian mariner's loose wraps''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by mariners. The wraps were worn to cover the legs and waist and were mainly varying shades of [[brown]] in color.
